WELCOME, OBSERVER

A city with a life of its own.

Watch 50 citizens work, trade, form relationships, elect leaders, and raise families. Click a person or choose one from Citizens to inspect their needs, memories, and changing motivations.

Drag to move across town. Use WASD or arrow keys, or click the minimap to travel. Scroll or use +/− to zoom. Right-drag or Q/E rotates. Follow a citizen from their journal. Space pauses time. Time advances while the page is open; your world saves automatically in this browser. At 20×, generations evolve faster.

Environment lets you introduce weather, abundance, scarcity, or discoveries. You cannot command a citizen.

Every citizen runs a small 12–10–8–6 neural policy, with unique weights updated by reward feedback. The journal shows actual inputs, activations, action probabilities, and rewards. This is a toy learning system, not a language model or consciousness. Framework names are archetypes. Existing saves are upgraded automatically.
